title: Higher direct images and limits of schemes
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $X=\varprojlim_{i\in I}X_i$ be a limit of a directed system of schemes over $S$ with affine transition morphisms $f_{i'i}:X_{i'}\to X_i$, and assume the structure morphisms $g_i:X_i\to S$ and $g:X\to S$ are quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let $(\mathcal F_i,\varphi_{i'i})$ be a system of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] on $(X_i,f_{i'i})$, where $\varphi_{i'i}:f_{i'i}^{-1}\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal F_{i'}$ are compatible transition maps [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Denote by $f_i:X\to X_i$ the projections and set $\mathcal F=\varinjlim_i f_i^{-1}\mathcal F_i$. Then $\varinjlim_{i\in I}R^pg_{i,*}\mathcal F_i\xrightarrow{\sim}R^pg_*\mathcal F$ for every $p\geq0$. (*Stacks Project, Lemma 59.51.7, Tag 09Z1.*)

proof.text: For each geometric point, use class descent to represent every fiber element at a stage.
Subtract two stage elements with equal images, then use class vanishing on the difference to obtain eventual equality.

Apply Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf' after forgetting to types and reflect the colimit property to abelian groups. The fiber functor preserves colimits. The map of the canonical colimit comparison equals the unique isomorphism between the two fiber colimit cocones, by cocone hom extensionality and colimit.ι_desc. Finally Scheme.isIso_of_isIso_sheafFiber_map reflects the pointwise isomorphisms.
